conditions: The current schema observation contains title:text, status:status with Planned, In Progress, and Done, and projectUri:relation to projects.records.
The governed field documentation contains title:text, status:status with Planned and Done, and projectUri:relation to projects.records.
The registered provider mirror contains title:text, status:status with Planned and Done, and projectUri:relation to projects.records, and is bound to the same synthetic observation authority.
All inputs are contained records with exact fingerprints; no provider call or document write is available.
